evals.prompt: Build a simple product landing page with a hero heading, a short paragraph, a secondary call-to-action line, and a two-column feature grid. It needs to look good on phones and desktops.
evals.expected_output: HTML/CSS page with a small type scale, readable contrast (WCAG AA), and a responsive mobile-first layout that works at ~375px and ~1200px+.
expectations: Font sizes come from a small fixed set (CSS custom properties), no one-off pixel sizes
All text passes WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large) against its background
Layout is single-column at phone width and expands to multiple columns at desktop

evals.prompt: Create an HTML email template for a weekly newsletter with a title, body text, a muted footer line, and a button. The grey secondary text keeps coming out too faint to read.
evals.expected_output: HTML email template with a deliberate type scale, dark enough grey secondary text, and a responsive single-column layout.
expectations: Grey secondary text is readable (passes contrast check), not faint
Uses a small set of font sizes rather than ad-hoc sizes
Responsive layout works on narrow phone screens

evals.prompt: Add a navigation bar and a card section to an existing page. The current page uses random font sizes like 13px, 17px, and 19px everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Updated page with navigation and cards, using a consistent type scale, readable contrast, and a responsive layout.
expectations: Replaces ad-hoc font sizes with the defined type scale tokens
All text meets WCAG AA contrast against its background
Navigation and cards stack sensibly on phone width and expand on desktop
